empty_space.where: The bottom of Column 1 and Column 2 are completely empty, leaving 26% of the canvas unused and creating a highly unbalanced layout.
empty_space.effect: The poster looks unfinished and fails to utilize available space to present key experimental results.

small_visual_text.where: Figure 1 diagram labels and text inside the boxes are extremely small and illegible at a standard viewing distance.
small_visual_text.effect: The reader cannot easily follow the system architecture and workflow diagram.

main_result_hidden.where: The Results section lacks any visual representation (plots or tables) of the primary performance comparisons (communication efficiency and receiver freshness under the channel models).
main_result_hidden.effect: The reader must rely on brief qualitative bullet points rather than seeing the quantitative evidence supporting the paper's main claims.

layout.reason: With 26% of the canvas left entirely blank at the bottom of the first two columns, the poster suffers from a major layout imbalance and fails to utilize its space effectively.

readability.reason: The main body text is well-spaced and highly legible, though the text labels inside the Figure 1 diagram are too small to read comfortably.

fidelity.reason: The poster omits visual evidence for the primary performance results (efficiency and freshness comparisons), showing only a preliminary false-positive rate characterization curve in Figure 3.

holistic.reason: The poster is usable and the core concept is clear, but it has noticeable weaknesses including a large amount of unused canvas (26%) and a lack of visual plots demonstrating the main performance gains over the baselines.
